capabilities: Explore a problem's assumptions, definitions and reformulations before searching
Run multi-source literature search with graded, citation-linked synthesis
Track beliefs with revision history and sceptical pushback on framing
Design a research agenda of gaps and study designs for the next session
Export a methodological account as a portable JSON and BibTeX bundle
extras: Core search works free and keyless via OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar; LLM steps are opt-in and work with a local Ollama so all AI traffic can stay on-machine; no telemetry or account. Documented 13-language output, desktop and mobile support, and a debug-log note for troubleshooting.
motivation: The author built it to guard the thinking that AI summaries erode: after reading forty papers, you still need to reconstruct later why you concluded what you did, and keep the pen in your own hand.
problem: Obsidian has literature-search and vault-chat plugins but nothing structures the reasoning around research — assumptions, framing, belief revisions and a reconstructable audit trail.
